title: यम का दीया बुझा, तो दरवाज़ा खुला! #shorts
description: काल्पनिक कहानी। पूरी कहानी रात के किस्से पर।

characters.Arjun: Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, anxious eyes
characters.Nani: old Indian woman, 80, thin white hair, white cotton saree, deep wrinkles, piercing eyes
characters.Yamdeep: a tall faceless dark shadow figure with a faint red glow, wrapped in black smoke

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: नरक चतुर्दशी की रात, यम का दीया सुबह तक नहीं बुझना चाहिए। पर अगर बुझ जाए तो?
scenes.visual: Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, anxious eyes, Old Indian haveli doorway at night, a single clay lamp burning, fog

scenes.speaker: A
scenes.text: आधी रात के बाद कोई तुम्हारा नाम पुकारे, तो पलटकर मत देखना।
scenes.visual: old Indian woman, 80, thin white hair, white cotton saree, deep wrinkles, piercing eyes, Old woman's piercing eyes in lamp light

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रात के ठीक बारह बजे, दीया फड़फड़ाने लगा।
scenes.visual: Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, anxious eyes, Lamp flame flickering violently in strong wind at haveli doorway

scenes.speaker: G
scenes.visual: a tall faceless dark shadow figure with a faint red glow, wrapped in black smoke, Dark corridor behind the man, faint shadow shape, fog

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और दक्षिण का दरवाज़ा... अपने आप खुलने लगा।
scenes.visual: Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, anxious eyes, Old wooden door creaking open by itself, red glow inside

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आगे क्या हुआ? पूरी कहानी रात के किस्से पर देखिए, लिंक नीचे है।
scenes.visual: Indian man, 30, short black hair, light stubble, maroon sweater over white kurta, holding a brass oil lamp, anxious eyes, Haveli at night with a single lamp burning, fog
